scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Shoo, I don't need a child. Shoo! I don't talk to novices.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
走开，我不需要小孩子。走开！我不跟初心者说话。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Go reach a level that can fight with stronger monsters and come back.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
去提升等级，能跟更强的魔物战斗了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Say do you like Pumpkin Pies?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
话说，你喜欢南瓜派吗？

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I'm a Pumpkin Hat researcher, Why don't you listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
我是南瓜帽研究员，要不要听听我的故事？

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 听故事

scripts.text: Ask about Pumpkin Hat.
scripts.translation: 询问南瓜帽

scripts.text: Get a Pumpkin Hat.
scripts.translation: 获取南瓜帽

scripts.text: Stop the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I've been studying about an upgraded Pumpkin Hat.
I have discovered that it is a very simple process.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
我一直在研究升级版的南瓜帽。
我发现这个过程非常简单。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
The process is quite simple.
If you bring me ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000 I can show you.
Isn't that a tempting proposal?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
过程相当简单。
如果你给我^4a4aff20南瓜头^000000，我就可以展示给你看。
这难道不是一个诱人的提议吗？

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
This upgraded pumpkin hat is powerful stuff!
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
这顶升级版的南瓜帽非常厉害！

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
It can make a Pumpkin Pie that restores a large percentage of HP & SP using condensed energy to the person who wears it.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
它能利用凝聚的能量，为佩戴者制作出能恢复大量HP和SP的南瓜派。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
All you need is ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
你只需要^4a4aff20南瓜头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Do you want to get Pumpkin Pies? Okay, let me count the Jack o' Pumpkins you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
你想获得南瓜派吗？好的，让我数一下你带来的南瓜头。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I need ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000.
I'm not an alchemist or a wizard to create something from nothing.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
我需要^4a4aff20南瓜头^000000。
我又不是炼金术士或巫师，不能无中生有。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Okay, go hunting monsters and come back.
I'm going to stay here for a while so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
好的，去狩猎魔物，然后回来。
我会在这里待一会儿，所以不用着急。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I hope this will be useful to you. Don't forget to wear it while fighting to get your Pumpkin Pies.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
希望这对你有用。战斗时别忘了戴上它，这样才能获得南瓜派。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I guess that I should get back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
我想我该回去继续研究了。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Bye, until we'll see each other again.
I wish you well...
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究员]
再见，期待下次见面。
祝你一切顺利...

scripts.text:
[Trick or Treater]
Hooray! hooray! Hooray!
Trick or Treat?
scripts.translation:
[讨糖的孩子]
万岁！万岁！万岁！
不给糖就捣蛋？

scripts.text: Trick.
scripts.translation: 捣蛋

scripts.text: Treat.
scripts.translation: 给糖

!!!!
Fine. I have no choice but to trick you back!
scripts.translation:

!!!!
好吧。我别无选择，只能对你捣蛋了！

Oh yay! What kind of treat do you have?

scripts.translation: 糖果

scripts.text: Candy Cane

scripts.text: Well-baked Cookie

Here, take this for being so nice!

看在这里这么友善的份上，收下这个吧！

[Halloween Wizard]
...
Do you want to play a trick on someone?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
...
你想捉弄谁吗？

scripts.text: What trick?
scripts.translation: 什么捉弄？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
I can summon monsters in other parts of the world with just a few materials.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
只要有一些材料，我就能在世界其他角落召唤魔物。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
Sounds interesting huh?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
听起来很有趣，对吧？

scripts.text:

If you bring me Fabric, Jack o' Pumpkins, Worn Fabric, or Crushed Pumpkins I can summon the monsters.
scripts.translation:

如果你给我布料、南瓜头、支离破碎的布片或破掉的南瓜头，我就能召唤魔物。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
Ok then let's go to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
好的，那让我们进入下一步。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
How many Fabrics or Jack o' Pumpkins do you want to use? Don't go over 100 because that is the max amount that I can use.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
你想使用多少布料或南瓜头？不要超过100，因为那是我能使用的最大数量。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
You have no definite idea.
It's not a big deal.
Let me know.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
你还没有确定的想法。
没关系。
告诉我吧。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
I told you that it must be between 1 to 100!
You didn't pay attention!
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
我告诉过你，必须在1到100之间！
你没在听吗！

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
Recount the number of items you have and tell me the total.
Huhuhuhuhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
数一数你有多少物品，然后告诉我总数。
呼呼呼呼呼...

scripts.text: Theres a problem.
scripts.translation: 出问题了。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
Here's what you wanted.
Imagine what the people must be thinking in the other villages?
Muahahaha
scripts.translation:
[万圣节巫师]
给你，这就是你想要的。
想象一下其他村庄的人现在在想什么？
穆哈哈哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
If you change your mind, come back here...
I'll stay here for a while...
Kkkk...
scripts.translation:

如果你改变主意了，就回来这里...
我会在这里待一会儿...
咯咯咯...
